### TAG-175: Anonymous Single Return to VHDL

**Status:** ⬜ Not started

## Software Notes

TAG-142/146/153/160's `" <= AB;"`/`"<= null_value;"` with a **blank identifier** before `<=`, and "design file is empty" — this points at an *unnamed* fill (`dest_name == ""`, the abbreviated single-return form we built much earlier) getting passed through `sanitizeName`, which strips all non-alphanumeric characters from an empty string and returns an empty string — producing an invalid VHDL line with no identifier at all. This is a **separate, real design question** (how does an anonymous single-return value get represented as a named VHDL port at all?) — not something to patch inline here. I'd file this as its own issue rather than rush a fix into an already-large change.
